item.title: Finding Symbol Commands for LaTeX
item.description: Ever been writing a document in [latex]\LaTeX[/latex] and had to look up the code for a particular symbol? Google usually directs me to the but scrolling through and finding the symbol I’m looking for is time consuming. However, today I came across this site ( ) which lets you draw the symbol you are looking for and it tries to match it, providing symbol suggestions and letting you know the [latex]\LaTeX[/latex] code and the package to use!
